title: Rectangle Area
summary: Given the coordinates of the bottom-left and top-right corners of two rectilinear rectangles in a 2D plane, calculate the total area covered by both rectangles.
statement: Given the coordinates of the bottom-left and top-right corners of two rectilinear rectangles in a 2D plane, calculate the total area covered by both rectangles.
constraints: All coordinates are integers from -10000 to 10000; ax1≤ax2, ay1≤ay2, bx1≤bx2, by1≤by2. Zero-width/height rectangles are allowed.
Rectangles are axis-aligned, given by bottom-left and top-right corners. Return their union area, counting overlap once; touching only along an edge or corner adds no overlap area.
reference_solution:
def rectangle_union_area(ax1, ay1, ax2, ay2, bx1, by1, bx2, by2):
    first = (ax2 - ax1) * (ay2 - ay1)
    second = (bx2 - bx1) * (by2 - by1)
    width = max(0, min(ax2, bx2) - max(ax1, bx1))
    height = max(0, min(ay2, by2) - max(ay1, by1))
    return first + second - width * height

def rectangle_union_area(ax1, ay1, ax2, ay2, bx1, by1, bx2, by2):
    first = (ax2 - ax1) * (ay2 - ay1)
    second = (bx2 - bx1) * (by2 - by1)
    width = min(ax2, bx2) - max(ax1, bx1)
    height = min(ay2, by2) - max(ay1, by1)
    return first + second - width * height
hints: Adding the individual areas counts the shared region twice.
Intersect the x intervals and the y intervals separately to find overlap dimensions.
Clamp both overlap dimensions at zero, multiply them, and subtract that overlap from the two individual areas.
Negative coordinates do not change the formula; degenerate rectangles and touching edges have zero overlap area.
editorial: Inclusion-exclusion counts each point once: area(A)+area(B)−area(A∩B). The intersection of axis-aligned rectangles is an axis-aligned rectangle only when both overlap dimensions are positive, so clamp each dimension independently before multiplying. The independent oracle partitions the plane using all input x/y boundaries and sums coordinate cells covered by either rectangle; it does not reuse the overlap formula. All arithmetic remains integral, including the full-domain 400000000 area.
